0x000938.en: A class of anti-alien mobile weapons evolved from fighter craft. The <Tesla Drive>, a thruster separating gravitational and inertial mass, lets them fly unaided and outmaneuver any fighter. The DC's mainstay in the DC War; <Isurugi Heavy Ind.> still builds them for the Federation.

0x0014FD.en: A standard measure of the <Telekinesis Alpha Pulse>. Highly focused people tend to score high; past a set value, one possesses telekinesis. It also shows a subject's compatibility with the <T-LINK System>.

0x001F14.en: fA long-established leader in shipbuilding, power plants and aircraft, with a strong aerospace record and a major defense role. While supplying Federation fighters like the F-32 Schwert, it dealt with the <EOTI Organization> and secretly mass-produced the Lion series during the <DC War>. The series ironically became the Federation mainstay after the <L5 Campaign>, so its DC ties went unpunished to secure production.

0x002F6B.en: 'Aerogaters' is the Earth codename for the force that struck the Earth Sphere from Neviim, an automated planet that appeared suddenly at L5, using insectoid mobile weapons like the Megillot. They schemed to exploit humanity's superior combat ability for themselves, but lost in Operation SRW, the L5 Campaign's finale. They proved to be humans mentally conditioned by an unknown party - a fact kept strictly secret.

0x0036B6.en: A plan to develop special humanoid weapons for anti-alien combat. Units like the R-Series apply <EOT> extensively.

0x003F05.en:
The first fully sealed space colony, completed in New Era 075. It houses the Colony Integrated Government and the headquarters of the <Colony Integ. Army>. Colony history through the 180s was one of hardship: civil strife in 076 after the first emigrants' adaptation surgery failed; a terrorist bid for autonomy in 157 (the Nozomi Incident); a bulkhead bombing in 172 (the Hope Incident); and a BC-weapon attack in 184 (the Elpis Incident), each costing many lives.
From the early 160s the NID4 movement sought self-rule by peaceful means. Its leader, Brian Midcrid, won over Earth's public opinion, achieved independence in 184, and became the first president; the Federation space forces stationed there became the <Colony Integ. Army> under supreme commander Maier.
The ten colonies, all at L4, are No. 1 Elpis, No. 2 Nozomi, No. 3 Hoffnung, No. 4 Wish, No. 5 Espoir, No. 6 Hope, No. 7 Space, No. 8 Esperanza, No. 9 Speranza, and No. 10 Nadezhda.

0x005160.en:
Shura Gods are the weapons of the Shura, powered by their handlers' life energy. Ranks include 'Retsu,' 'Gou,' and 'Chou' class; the lowest, Retsu, can be piloted by any Shura with enough fighting spirit (life energy) and skill.
Gou- and Chou-class machines choose their riders: becoming one's handler demands strength, trials, and rites, and once a handler is chosen, no other can pilot it until that person dies. They are said to hold a will of their own, admitting only those they accept - an unqualified rider has their spirit drained and dies. Gou class and above were built with lost technology today's Shura cannot reproduce, so they are few; some have served for centuries, and several lie sealed, awaiting handlers.
A Gou-class handler holds respect and authority among the Shura, and piloting a Chou-class machine is required to become a Shura general. Retsu-class units are copies of surviving Gou-class machines - far weaker, but mass-producible.

0x00668B.en: A global political body that grew from a provisional UN organ amid the chaos after the AD 2012 meteor disaster ('Double Impact'). Though it stands above the existing nations as an international authority, it never unified all governance, and older regional conflicts carried over unresolved.

0x007831.en:
A military organization founded from the <EOTI Organization> by Dr. Bian Zoldark, who foresaw an alien invasion. Its aim was a strong military regime in the Earth Sphere to oppose the invaders. It drew Federation officials and soldiers, anti-Federation activists, and liberation fighters; the <Colony Integ. Army> cooperated as well.
In late New Era 186 it rose against the <Earth Fed Gov't> and its army, seizing bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s. But Bian and commander Maier V. Branstein's plan was double-edged: by playing the 'enemy' they meant to rouse humanity to fight, yet a long civil war risked draining Earth's strength. They thus sought a quick end to the DC War while sparing much of the Federation's forces, and Bian would entrust the Earth Sphere's future to any strong enough to defeat him.
That contradiction invited his defeat and emboldened those exploiting the DC for selfish ends. He died in the Hagane's raid on DC headquarters; the leaderless DC fell apart and lost to the Federation Army.

0x0087BB.en: A squad formed to research and develop combat techniques and motion data for humanoid mobile weapons. The basic motion data in the <TC-OS> of current Personal Troopers came from their repeated trials. Its six elites were captain Kar-Wai Lau, Kai Kitamura, Tempest Hawker, Sanger Zonvolt, Elzam V. Branstein, and Gilliam Yeager. It disbanded after an incident in New Era 184, but its colorful members and achievements made it semi-legendary in and beyond the Federation Army. It was re-formed after the <L5 Campaign>, with Kai Kitamura as captain.

0x0098EE.en: A military organization formed after the <L5 Campaign> by Van Vat Tran, uniting <DC> remnants and anti-Federationists with <Shadow Mirror> aid. It rose in New Era 187 to unify the Earth Sphere by force, but its true foes were the invading aliens, and the Inspectors' arrival brought a truce with the Federation. During the North America recapture Van died to a Shadow Mirror plot and the group collapsed; remnants fight on as guerrillas.

0x00A212.en: Human life energy, akin to aura or ki. It cloaks the body and swells with emotion. <La Gias> natives show smaller swings than surface folk.

0x00ACCF.en: Self-repairing, self-evolving metal cells made by Dr. Egret Feff. They can also invade matter, quickly rewriting a touched object's composition to strengthen it and take control. Development predates the <DC War>, but a sample of the self-aware metal cells (Zfylud Crystal) in <Aerogaters> weapons boosted them greatly. In the <Inspector Incident> they were also used in the <Neue DC> machines Thrudgelmir and Bergelmir, showing remarkable regeneration.

0x00B62C.en: Short for 'Moon Orbital Search System.' An automated early-warning system of unmanned probes dotted across a sphere bounded by the Moon's orbit. Superior to the Satellite Link System (a satellite air-defense network), it was built by the Colony Integration Army before the DC War; the Federation Army now runs it.

0x00BF97.en: RNickname of the quantum computer in Solatis Temple.
